title: Replying to @hollymasen filmed this for you at 3:30am when i got home...
transcript: This is me after going to a heated rivalry Halloween party. I have no idea what anybody wrote. The only ones I could see were the kind of, like, these ones, like here and here. Does the back look good? Oh, this is cute. And I got third in the costume contest. Gay hockey players with big butts. And I also got a poster of Susan autographed by the cast. I'm a little nervous because someone said that I should have worn a white shirt under this because it might have bled through. We're gonna find out together if there's marker all over my body. I don't think there's any marker. See a lot of glitter. What is that from? Is that glitter or sweat? It's 3:00am. Oh, my god, it looks so good. Do you boys listen to David Guetta? Oh, my god, there's so many fun quotes. W I C T M C T S Y U K. Will you come to my cottage? That's so cute. Took me a second to get. Yes, I think so. Probably. Oh, that is a phone number. Someone wrote their phone number? Honestly, hot. We love being brave. You're brave, but not like I love you. Wait. This shirt is so cute. I feel like I just wanna keep wearing this to heated rivalry events. I'll just have to keep having people sign it. I need to, like, iron him on. Actually, it is Velcro, so I can just, like, take Him off, wash him and stick him right back on. Happy heated rivalry Halloween!
